name: IF-VidCap
abstract: IF-VidCap evaluates instruction following in video captioning. This page uses the Overall CSR from the main table.
method: This work argues that video captioning should evaluate not only content coverage, but also whether models truly follow explicit instructions on format, keywords, and structure.
IF-VidCap combines rule-based and open-ended constraints to systematically assess instruction following in video captioning.
The main results show clear advantages for leading closed-source and strong open-source multimodal models, yet strict instruction following remains unsolved.
